title: Dryden Vos
description: Dryden Vos was a gangster of wealth and taste who served as the public face of Crimson Dawn for his mysterious master, Maul. Quick to anger, but also charismatic and someone who enjoyed the finer things, he could switch from smiles to ruthless killer in a heartbeat. He put a lot of trust in his lieutenant, Qi'ra, which ultimately cost him everything.
